claims.hypothesis: Do the SMGs follow the main sequence or lie in a starburst mode?
claims.experiment: MAGPHYS SFR and M* compared with Speagle et al. 2014 MS
claims.result: 57.3% on MS, 41.9% above MS by factor >3
claims.finding: SMGs comprise both highly star-forming MS galaxies and starbursts

evidence.quote: Seventy-one of our SMGs ($57.3\%\pm6.8\%$) have $1/3 < \Delta_{\rm MS} \leq3$

claims.hypothesis: Do starbursts exhaust gas faster than MS SMGs?

evidence.quote: For the super-MS SMGs, $\tau_{\rm dep}$ is found to lie in the range of about 30 Myr–5.6 Gyr, with a median of 407 Myr.

claims.hypothesis: Do ALMA 1.3 mm-selected AzTEC SMGs have the same property distributions as 870 um ALESS SMGs?
claims.experiment: Welch t-test and KS tests vs flux-matched ALESS sample
claims.result: KS p-values 0.003-0.22 for most parameters, 0.48 for L_dust
claims.finding: Distributions unlikely drawn from common parents, possibly due to selection wavelength

evidence.quote: the K-S test results suggest that the parameters are unlikely to be drawn from the same parent distribution (the $p$-values range from $p=0.003$ to $p=0.22$)

claims.hypothesis: Are z>3 SMGs progenitors of z~2 compact quiescent galaxies?
claims.experiment: Mass-size and stellar mass distribution comparison with Krogager et al. 2014
claims.result: 21%+-5% of 98 within the mass-radio size relation; final-mass KS D=0.22, p=0.33
claims.finding: Only broadly consistent; link not universal

evidence.quote: Similarly to the mass-size relationship, the mass distribution analysis presented here is only roughly consistent with the proposed evolutionary connection

why_this_method.value: Large homogeneous multiwavelength sample in COSMOS enables panchromatic SED fitting; 1.3 mm dust used as gas tracer since CO is available for only two sources

evidence.quote: To our knowledge, only two of our target SMGs have a published CO tracer-based molecular gas mass estimate available

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: AGN-host candidates removed rather than modelled, since MAGPHYS lacks an AGN component

evidence.quote: AGN-host galaxies need to be discounted from an analysis of SED properties.

limitations_admitted.value: Gas masses depend on uniform Galactic alpha_CO; may be overestimated by factor >~8 if alpha_CO ~0.8

evidence.quote: then the dust-based gas masses can be overestimated by a factor of $\gtrsim8$

limitations_admitted.value: Selection bias at z>~3 toward warmer, brighter sources

evidence.quote: our $z\gtrsim3$ SMGs are likely biased towards warmer objects than at lower redshifts

referee_caveats_inferred: Energy balance assumes stellar and dust emission are co-spatial, which may fail for SMGs
Photometric redshifts dominate (100/124); only 5 z>3 sources spectroscopic
Many binned fits have low significance and small number statistics
ALMA data are only used as flux densities; the ALMA reduction itself is not documented here

data_public_as_stated.value: Public tools and COSMOS data; ALMA data acknowledged by project codes; SED code publicly available

evidence.quote: `MAGPHYS` is publicly available, and can be retrieved at `http://www.iap.fr/magphys/magphys/MAGPHYS.html`.

missing_for_reproduction: Aravena et al. ALMA 1.3 mm catalogue (in prep.) and calibrated fluxes

reproducibility.estimated_data_volume_inferred: Small if the published photometry table is used (~MB); raw ALMA data of 2013.1.00118.S ~tens of GB
reproducibility.score_reason: Photometry is tabulated and MAGPHYS is public so the SED analysis is reproducible; the ALMA reduction and some inputs are in companion papers.
reproducibility.rediscovery_reason: ALMA role is a single flux per source taken from an unpublished catalogue; the main results come from SED fits that need external companion data.
